IC1: Type II diabetic patients, 18 years and older, were included if the participants had:
IC2: 1. severe [NOT] non-PDR in either eyes with/ [NOT] without diabetic macular edema;
IC3: 2. ETDRS letters-measured best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) ranging from 20/40 to 20/320 Snellen equivalent;
IC4: 3. [NOT] no previous treatment (of any type) in either eye.
